_doc: ONECHAT OC1 routing corpus (handover §4.8, test 1.1). Every row asserts route AND why; the other keys are asserted when present. P = payobook (pb_payai_actions, PayAI can act, an assistant that is set up); B = pb_learn's base behaviour (no assistant, no command path). `state` rows need a conversation state: plan_amber / plan_amber_voice (company counts a spoken go-ahead and the person has a microphone) / plan_red / reason_open. Values were OBSERVED by the offline harness (pb_payai_actions/tests/offline) and reviewed against the handover; the server tests replay the same file on the clone.
